# vcraft 1.4.3

A small feature release: extra compiler and linker flags in the manifest.

## Added

- **`[build] cflags` and `[build] ldflags`.** Extra flags for the C compiler and linker can
  now be persisted in `vcraft.toml`, passed to V as `-cflags`/`-ldflags` after vcraft's own.
  This is how a project opts into something like `-march=x86-64-v2` once instead of passing
  `--cflags` on every build. A CLI `--cflags`/`--ldflags` adds to the manifest's flags
  rather than replacing them, and `vcraft info` reports both.

A wheel built with `-march` inherits that CPU requirement, so it belongs in a private build
or a deliberate platform baseline, not in a wheel meant to run on any x86-64.

## Upgrade

```console
$ pip install --upgrade vcraft
```

Full list in
[CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/rroblf01/vcraft/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#143---2026-10-16).
